producer_report.summary: validate_item in crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs now refuses a non-blind-spot item that cites fewer than two distinct instances (MIN_EVIDENCE = 2). A repeated failure counts distinct jobs only. A proposal counts distinct references other than its own source. The reason names the key, says "one instance is not a general weakness" and gives the count ("1 distinct ..."). Blind spots are exempt. New test `one_instance_is_not_a_general_weakness` covers: one job; a job plus a path; a job plus a made-up commit; a job cited twice (once padded with spaces); a proposal that echoes its own source; the accepted two-instance forms; and the blind-spot exemption. Fixtures were updated: core `item()` cites two jobs, with a `records_with_jobs` helper. In the CLI steward tests, two proposals now cite a second distinct reference, `bad:request` has two jobs, and a new `bad:evidence` case checks the reason end to end. docs/spec.toml OLY-5-07 now has a mechanism, owner Athena, and measure `cargo test -p athena-core steward; status: not shown`. The mechanism text claims only the evidence-floor half. The "inappropriate universal rules" clause is stated as not mechanized. Also added: enforcement row M34 and a CHANGELOG entry. Manual check: with MIN_EVIDENCE set to 0 the new test fails ("accepted RepeatedFailure with [StewardRefOutput { kind: Job, value: \"20261010-153012-k7q2\" }]"). With 2 restored it passes.

open_issues: Only the demonstrated-general-weakness half of OLY-5-07 is mechanized. The clause on inappropriate universal rules is not, and the measure stays `status: not shown`.

The steward prompt is unchanged (out of scope), so the model is not told that two instances are needed; early steward runs may lose one-instance items to the new refusal. The steward brief already defines generality as two or more failed jobs.
The rule counts references, not whether two jobs show the same failure.
Open question for the owner: a docs-only proposal (two distinct paths other than its source) is accepted; repeated failures need two jobs.
learnings: Bash in this environment forbids pipes to grep, head and tail; use the Grep tool or run cargo directly.
Reference derives PartialEq and Eq but not Hash or Ord, so distinctness is checked with Vec::contains.
check_reference does not check that commits or paths exist, which is why the repeated-failure count uses jobs only.
